description: This file provides utility functions for reading files if they exist and collecting plugin source information from a 'extensions' directory within a repository. It heavily relies on Node.js 'fs' and 'path' modules to interact with the filesystem and parse JSON files related to plugins.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file at the specified path if it exists; returns null if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Aggregates plugin metadata from the 'extensions' directory within a repository. It scans directories, checks for required manifest files, optionally requires a package.json, and returns sorted plugin info objects.
